executive-summary.problem: Demo V2 (Phase 2: Ultra-Scale) has two performance bottlenecks: 1. Duplicate checks scale O(n) with corpus size (no pre-filtering) 2. Generation sequential for exact duplicates (5% of corpus)
executive-summary.solution: 1. Bloom Pre-Filter: Skip 50-90% duplicate checks with <30ns query (T10 Probabilistic) 2. Full Parallel Generation: Parallelize ALL sections (exact + near + unique) using T4 Batch
executive-summary.impact: - Speedup: 2-10× dedup pipeline + 1.05-1.1× generation (compound: 2.1-11× total) - Memory: +10MB Bloom filter (negligible) - Integration: Zero breaking changes (backward compatible)

data-structure.name: DedupBloomFilter

fields.field: Bit array: m = 1,000,000 bits (100K docs × 10 bits/element)

data-structure.memory-calculation: m = -n × ln(p) / (ln(2))^2 m = -100,000 × ln(0.0008) / (ln(2))^2 ≈ 1,000,000 bits ≈ 125 KB With AtomicU64 alignment: 125 KB → ~10 MB (8× overhead for lockfree safety)

bloom-filter-parameters.parameter: Bit array size (computed from n and p)
Number of hash functions (optimal for m and n)

best-case.speedup: 10× (90K docs × 100μs saved = 9 seconds, vs 1 second for 10K new docs)

performance-analysis.b32-honest-reporting: - Speedup varies with duplicate rate (2× at 50%, 10× at 90%, 1× at 0%) - False positives add overhead (0.08% × 100μs = 8ns average per doc) - Bloom filter memory (10MB) negligible vs MinHash signatures (50MB for 100K docs)

risk.name: Bloom Filter False Positive Rate Too High
risk.description: If Bloom filter FPR exceeds 0.08%, MinHash verification overhead increases, negating speedup gains (threshold: FPR > 1% → <2× speedup).

mitigation.action: Tune bit array size m to achieve target FPR (0.08%)
Property test: Measure actual FPR on 100K synthetic corpus (expect ≤ 0.08%)
Fallback: Increase m from 1M to 10M bits (10× memory, 0.008% FPR)

risk.fallback-plan: If FPR > 1%: Disable Bloom filter, revert to direct MinHash computation

risk.name: Parallel Generation Overhead Dominates
risk.description: For small corpora (<1K docs), rayon overhead (>10μs) exceeds parallel benefit, resulting in slowdown (threshold: overhead > 1% of generation time).

mitigation.action: Adaptive threshold: Use sequential for <1K documents
Optimization: Pre-allocate thread pool (avoid repeated initialization)

risk.fallback-plan: If overhead > 1%: Use sequential generation for <1K documents

risk.name: Cache Thrashing from Parallel Generation
risk.description: If parallel threads compete for L3 cache (16MB on 6900HX), cache miss rate increases, degrading throughput (threshold: L3 miss rate > 5% → <1.1× speedup).

mitigation.action: Thread-local buffers: Rayon uses thread-local allocations (no shared Vec)
perf stat: Measure L3 cache miss rate (expect <5%)
NUMA awareness: Pin threads to NUMA nodes (future optimization)

risk.fallback-plan: If L3 miss rate > 5%: Reduce thread count (8 cores instead of 16)

risk.name: Bloom Filter Lockfree Race Condition
risk.description: If AtomicU64 bit array has race condition, Bloom filter may miss documents, causing false negatives (threshold: FN rate > 0% → accuracy degradation).

mitigation.action: Code inspection: Verify AtomicU64 ordering (Relaxed for reads, Release for writes)
Concurrency test: 16 threads × 100K ops concurrent insert/query (no data race)
Property test: Sequential vs concurrent Bloom filter produce same FPR

risk.fallback-plan: If FN rate > 0%: Add Mutex around Bloom filter (sacrifice lockfree for correctness)
